name: CUDA kernel review
instruction:
Explain the selected CUDA / GPU code with focus on:

1. Launch geometry (grid/block) and what each thread owns
2. Memory hierarchy: registers, SMEM, GMEM, TMEM if present; coalescing and bank conflicts
3. Synchronization and pipelines (barriers, async copies, warp specialization)
4. Numerical / MMA / tensor-core details when relevant
5. Likely bottlenecks and safe optimization ideas

Use precise terminology. Prefer diagrams only when Excalidraw is enabled. Match the explanation language requested by XPlain.
